hypothesis: Fine-tuning layer4 will improve validation macro-F1 over frozen ResNet18 without increasing faults predicted No-Anomaly.
test_policy: Do not use the test split for training or model selection.
budget_note: The smoke run suggests roughly 72 seconds for a full training pass and 10 seconds per validation pass. Including prediction collection, estimate about 90 seconds per epoch; four epochs should fit within 480 seconds.
stopping_rule: Stop after four epochs, two epochs without validation macro-F1 improvement, or 480 elapsed seconds, whichever comes first.
